# pixel-nas-unlimited-backup
> Unlimited media cloud backup via rooted Pixel + SMB NAS + rclone + Google Photos (no cifs required). Universal guide + Magisk module template.

Part of **Boryslav Deputat** public engineering portfolio (Austin, TX). Built with KLAV (UA AI) / КЛАВ (УКР ШІ).
